name: Correlated Sentinel + Defender Alerts (Auto Case)
description: Automatically creates a case when Microsoft Sentinel and Defender alerts correlate on the same host within 60 minutes.
query: (event.provider:("Microsoft Sentinel" or "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint")) and event.severity >= 3 and host.id:*

subActionParams.title: Correlated Sentinel + Defender alerts on {{context.group}}
